Large free public skate parks, including Singapore's biggest outdoor skate park.
Free BMX riding at the Xtreme SkatePark and a UCI-certified BMX track at Tampines Bike Park.
Singapore has no velodrome; a SportSG feasibility study was still ongoing as of last reports, and local cyclists train on roads.
